title: Number of Unique Good Subsequences
goal: Count distinct good binary subsequences without leading zeroes except the single zero.
strategy: Track distinct valid subsequences ending in zero and one. Appending the current bit replaces that ending count with all prior valid endings; one additionally starts a new subsequence. Count the single zero separately.
